result.fix: Add `systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=0` to the kernel command line in your boot loader's configuration and reboot. systemd 256 and 257 also need `SYSTEMD_CGROUP_ENABLE_LEGACY_FORCE=1` on the command line. systemd 258 and later, and RHEL 10, have no cgroup v1. Use an OS release that still has it.
result.message: cgroup v2 in use, v1 needed
